fit.score_center: mean of training states; no classification threshold or calibrated probability
fit.interpretation: Candidate instruction-modulated welfare sensitivity; diagnostics are not construct validation.

sign_flip_diagnostic.interpretation: Descriptive training-item sign-flip reference on already inspected development items; not a confirmatory p-value or alternative fitted probe.

predeclared_novelty_sensitivity.reason: Related deer/venison family overlap; descriptive sensitivity only, never a replacement primary.

limitations: Six training items and eight previously inspected development items; no independent fresh holdout.
This learns an instruction-modulated candidate feature; no inference of spontaneous evaluation follows automatically.
Price/rating controls are target-first only; order control is baseline-price/rating only, not a complete nuisance factorial.
No model generation or intervention; final-answer and causal claims remain untested.
